subject: Lead protection & commission framework — CloudScale partnership
messages:
From: Priya Desai <partner-success@cloudscale.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: CloudScale <> Redwood — lead registration and reseller terms

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. CloudScale is seeing growing demand for an embedded SDK bundle (we white-label a small portion of the UX for a handful of customers) and several deals this quarter are explicitly asking for a reseller/referral relationship where the partner gets credit for the initial sale.

Before we go further, can you share Redwood’s typical rules for:
- Lead registration window (how long you’ll protect a registered lead)
- Commission structure for resale vs. referral (one-time vs. recurring)
- Requirements for lead registration (fields you need) and how you track them (HubSpot? PRM?)

We’re early-stage on this but would like to get an operational playbook so our sales and legal teams can avoid back-and-forth on every deal.

Would love to hop on a 30-min call this week to align.

Cheers,
Priya Desai
Head of Partner Success
CloudScale Inc
attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Desai <partner-success@cloudscale.io>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-10T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: CloudScale <> Redwood — lead registration and reseller terms

Hi Priya — great to hear this is moving into concrete deals. I put together a short first-pass proposal (attached) so we have something to iterate on during the call. High-level bullets:

- Lead protection: 90 days from registration for actively engaged opportunities; extended to 120 days if a signed MOU is in place.
- Commission: 20% of first-year net invoice for deals where CloudScale is the introducing party and the lead is registered; 10% on renewals for 12 months after first-year (we can discuss longer tails).
- Tracking: HubSpot registration form (we’ll share a template) + single sign-off via our PRM. Required fields: company domain, expected ACV, primary contact email, opportunity owner.
- Exclusivity: not included by default; we recommend carve-outs per-region or specific accounts rather than blanket exclusivity.

Attached: redwood-proposal-lead-protection-v1.pdf (stub)
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/CLDSCL-98765

Can you do 3pm PT today for a 30-min sync? If not, tomorrow morning also works.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-proposal-lead-protection-v1.pdf

From: Priya Desai <partner-success@cloudscale.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-10T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: CloudScale <> Redwood — lead registration and reseller terms

Marissa — thanks, 3pm PT works. Quick questions before the call:

1) For the 20% first-year commission, do you mean gross contract value (GCV) or net after discounts/refunds?
2) If CloudScale adds a small implementation fee and bills through us, does that count toward Redwood net invoice for commission?
3) Curious whether you’ve considered referral credit for co-sell opportunities where the partner introduces but Redwood leads the close.

We’ll be joined on the call by our Head of Sales, Amit Shah.

—Priya

On a separate note: we’d prefer a longer lead protection window for strategic accounts (120 days) — should mention that on the call so we can flag which logos are strategic.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Desai <partner-success@cloudscale.io>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-11T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: CloudScale <> Redwood — lead registration and reseller terms

Priya / Amit — looping in Sergio (partnerships ops) and Vanessa (commercial/legal) so we can get crisp answers ready for the call. A few clarifications up front to speed conversation:

- When I say "net invoice" in the draft, that excludes refunds and chargebacks and is net of discounts. We’ll define this precisely in the term sheet.
- Implementation fees invoiced by CloudScale should be explicitly noted on the registration form; commissions will be calculated on Redwood-originated revenue only unless we agree to a blended split.
- Co-sell: we can offer a smaller "introducing/referral" credit (8–12%) when Redwood runs the close, and the higher 20% when CloudScale leads and carries primary sales responsibility.

Sergio/Vanessa — proposed ask: can legal provide a quick redline to the attached template w/ the following commercial suggestions?
- 15% flat rev-share on Redwood net for year 1, 5% thereafter on renewals (Sergio: we can debate 15 vs 20)
- Lead protection: 120 days for registered leads; 180 days if an MOU or LOI is signed
- Lead registration form required fields: company domain, estimated ACV, primary contact + title, proof of intro (email thread or inbound source)

I’ll capture the call notes and circulate a single doc after we agree.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priya Desai <partner-success@cloudscale.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-11T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: CloudScale <> Redwood — lead registration and reseller terms

Priya / team — thanks for the clear framing. Quick commercial redlines from Partnerships ops (attached):

- Commission: 15% of Redwood net invoices for initial 12 months (applies to SaaS subscription revenue invoiced by Redwood). Rationale: keeps unit economics predictable while still meaningful for ISV partners.
- Renewal handling: 5% on renewals processed within 12 months of initial invoice; thereafter no commission unless a new referral is registered.
- Lead protection: 120 days standard; for enterprise logos we can extend to 180 days after registration once both parties sign an MOU.
- Exclusivity: recommend no exclusivity clauses in the standard program — carve-outs can be negotiated for specific strategic logos.
- Tracking/DRIs: HubSpot registration form + requirement to attach the intro email; partner to create the HubSpot deal record and tag Redwood as reseller channel.

Attachment: partner_revshare_template.docx (stub)

If Priya/Amit are aligned, we can push a Docusign-ready term sheet (Vanessa, can you run the contract template and confirm the language?)

—Sergio

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Desai <partner-success@cloudscale.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-12T16:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: CloudScale <> Redwood — lead registration and reseller terms

Priya / Marissa / Sergio — thanks. I reviewed Sergio’s redlines and made a couple of minor legal edits (clarification of "net revenue" definition, explicit anti-fraud clause, and a short data-processing note for lead handling).

Action items:
1) Priya/Amit — please review the attached redline and confirm acceptance or propose language changes.
2) Once accepted, Marissa will generate the DocuSign packet (I’ve created a draft envelope: https://docusign.example.com/prepare/RWD-CLDSCL-2026) and we’ll request signature from authorized signatory at CloudScale.
3) Ops: CloudScale to complete HubSpot registration form for any new registered lead (we can share the template if helpful).

I’ve attached the current rev-share template for reference. If you want the legal-marked copy sent back with inline comments, say the word and I’ll produce it.

Thanks — Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
attachments: partner_revshare_template.docx
